scientific_integrity: The exact two-tower phase law and joint multiplicity/gap scaling are derived analytically from cycle feasibility inequalities. The originating publication already proves the fixed-parameter two-cycle census. No independent audit or absolute priority claim is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Theorem concerns exact floor arithmetic and offset-parameter ensembles, not noisy trajectories or empirical frequency of orbit switching.
Full pointwise two-cycle census was published previously. Equivalence to an unindexed parameter ensemble result remains possible.
Finite exact-rational checks corroborate but do not prove continuum parameter claims.

The gap distribution uses two-stage selection: sample an additive phase uniformly (conditional on any two-cycle), then choose one cycle uniformly at that phase. It differs from selecting cycles uniformly across the entire parameter family.
title: Universal multiplicity and gap laws at the floor-affine two-cycle explosion
